entries.clue: Cloakroom tickets, a folding table and a bottle of sherry
Boarded or tiled, it takes every footstep in the house
A tap of the sword on each shoulder raised a man to this mounted rank
Where you sleep, curtains drawn against the morning light
A grand tea party, or the undignified squabble that erupts at one
Cloth you flick over surfaces to lift a week of settled fluff
Green sludge of soaked marrowfats, ladled out beside battered haddock
Tiny six-legged marchers that arrive in one long black column
Trick-taking forerunner of bridge, played at village hall evenings
Board of wood and hide, raised to turn a blow aside
Hinged, slitted face plate a helmet wearer pushes up for a breath of air
Ring the walls, cut the roads, then wait: hunger does the rest
Holy war preached from the pulpit that sent western armies east to Jerusalem
